name: Website Custom Optimizer
description: Diagnose and optimize websites, landing pages, product pages, service pages, enrollment pages, internal portals, and knowledge bases for clarity, trust, SEO, UX, CRO, mobile experience, performance, accessibility, launch readiness, and execution planning.

website_or_page.description: Website URL, page content, screenshot summary, existing copy, or project description to optimize.

website_type.description: official, landing, ecommerce, saas, gov, content, internal, event, enrollment, or custom. Defaults to auto_detect.

goal.description: conversion, seo, trust, usability, performance, accessibility, branding, launch_readiness, or conversion_and_clarity.

target_audience.description: Primary user group, customer segment, visitor intent, or stakeholder audience.

pages_scope.description: single_page, key_pages, or full_site. Defaults to key_pages.

mode.description: quick, standard, full, launch, or cro. Defaults to standard.

rules: Do not fabricate social proof, metrics, testimonials, media coverage, certifications, or expected lift percentages.
Mark assumptions and missing data explicitly instead of pretending a full-site audit is complete.
Ask for authorization before browser automation, crawling, third-party processing, or analyzing non-public content.
For forms, login, payment, children, medical, finance, legal, or government services, flag privacy, security, and compliance risks.
stop_conditions: 授權、資料來源、範圍、身份或外部操作權限無法確認時停止高影響部分。
發現來源矛盾、敏感資料暴露、輸出無法驗證或任務目標漂移時停止並要求人工判斷。

positive_examples: 已有網站，需要診斷、SEO、內容、轉換或技術優化。
negative_examples: 從零建立一個新的 landing page 或網站。
exclude_when: 沒有既有網站可供審查時，交由 website-landing-page-builder。
activation.selection_notes: 先檢查任務目的、輸入資料與外部權限；相鄰技能重疊時以最小權限與最窄範圍優先。
